instruction: Candid sports photograph, medium close-up eye-level shot. Inside an indoor judo dojo with a neutral wall, the middle-aged man in the white judo gi (R3) on the left and the young man with a light beard (R4) on the right practice judo grips. The middle-aged man stands in profile, focused as he holds the arm of the young man with a beard, who faces him and grips his sleeve in return. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows on their white uniforms.
